verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each user/seller has a separate wallet (docs-11) and that chargebacks create a dispute tied to that wallet with funds auto-deducted and returned, and that the platform can contest with proof (mangopay-docs-12, mangopay-docs-13). This supports per-seller dispute attribution and automatic balance impact, but there is no explicit documentation of an API or dashboard workflow for submitting evidence, nor confirmation that automated payouts flow back correctly post-resolution. missing for 10: explicit evidence-submission API/dashboard flow, confirmation of automatic balance reconciliation after dispute resolution, and independent corroboration of per-sub-merchant chargeback routing.
